schemaVersion.description: Format version of this file; bumped on breaking changes.

credit.description: Who keeps the list; show it next to the entries.

suggest.description: How to get a server listed.

sample.description: true when the items are made-up sample data (no token, no public source).

cached.description: Served from the local cache instead of the network (fresh enough or the network failed).

SourceStatus.description: How one source did during the build.

id.description: Stable id: slug of the name ("dir:" prefix), numbered when two entries share a name.

url.description: Link as written in the sheet (Discord invite or website).

invite.description: Invite code when url is a Discord invite (discord.gg/<code>, discord.com/invite/<code>), else null.

group.description: Column group of the sheet: "Official", "Countries & Regions", "Communities", "Teams", "People", "Creators", "Events", "Projects"; archive: "Retired/Completed/OnHiatus", "Inactive Servers".

section.description: Sub-section below the group, e.g. "Europe", "Track Styles", "Competitive".

region.description: Only for group "Countries & Regions": Europe, North America, Asia / Oceania, Middle East / Africa, South America.

active.description: false for entries of the sheet "The Archive".

alive.description: Discord answered for the invite: true = valid, false = expired or unknown invite (HTTP 404), null = not checked (no invite, offline, rate limited).

members.description: approximate_member_count of the invite lookup; null when unknown.

guildName.description: Server name as Discord reports it (the sheet's name can differ).

icon.description: Server icon on Discord's CDN, 64 px; null when the server has none or it was not looked up yet.

checked.description: "Checked on" date of the sheet's section (YYYY-MM-DD), the list maintainer's last check; null if not given.

Community.description: One Discord server of the community directory (a public Google Sheet kept by mx_eyebo / Mania Exchange).
